name: zrndr_commit_fog_color_params_if_changed
description: zRndr::CommitFogColorParamsIfChanged copies standard fog color params to the active params when any RGB channel differs by at least 0.01.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this zRndr fog helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zRndr fog source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x49b530 shows fabs(active RGB - standard fog color RGB) comparisons against 0.01 and a 0xa0-byte copy from g_fogColorParams to g_fogParamsActive when any channel reaches the threshold.
The native smoke verifies fog color params commit into the active block when the blue channel differs beyond the threshold.
